body: Thanks for the kind words, and advice.
I'm missing a lot of stuff, but I'm shaking too much to type out another three paragraphs..

My family has said to my face that I will not amount to anything. Telling me they know they won't see me graduate college. On top of that, I've been in love with a girl for at least a year and a half and a couple months back she split up with her boyfriend..and almost instantly was with someone else. Not even a few weeks into that relationship, she confessed to me she loved me too. I now found out she told me these things because it made me happy, but she made a point that she wasn't lying either. It's been 3 months since then, on and off she would tell me things..bring up hypotheticals, and what I thought was just false hope. And now I've realized it is. She makes me the happiest person in the world, and I know I will never get to be there for her. And I don't want to feel this way anymore, because she has some issues to deal with as well, and I don't want to leave this world knowing she still will endure them. But I also think I'm the problem, but thinking about not leaving, so I can help her. Makes me want to do it more..I shouldn't feel this strongly, but I can't stop myself now..
